suits.name: Pentacles
suits.domain: Material, Work, Physical Body, Wealth, Practicality

cards.name: Ace of Wands

meanings.upright: A powerful new creative beginning. The hand of the universe offers you a wand of pure potential—raw energy ready to manifest. This is the spark before the flame, the creative impulse that precedes action. A time of pure inspiration and enthusiasm.
meanings.reversed: Creative energy is blocked or delayed. You may be experiencing a lack of motivation or hesitating to begin something new. The spark is there but not catching fire. Consider what fears or obstacles are preventing you from starting.

cards.numerology: 1 - Beginnings, initiative, masculine principle, the spark of creation

kabbalah.path: 11 - The path of the Primum Mobile
kabbalah.meaning: The pure, undifferentiated divine will manifesting as creative impulse

cards.affirmation: I embrace new creative beginnings with passion and enthusiasm.
cards.career: New projects, entrepreneurial ventures, creative opportunities
cards.relationships: New romantic spark, passionate beginnings, creative partnerships
cards.spirituality: Spiritual awakening, divine inspiration, connection to higher purpose

cards.name: Two of Wands

meanings.upright: You stand at a vantage point, wand in hand, looking out over possibilities. This is the planning phase after the initial spark. You have the power and now you're choosing the direction. Worldly expansion and strategic decisions are highlighted.
meanings.reversed: Fear of leaving your comfort zone is holding you back. You may be over-analyzing instead of acting, or planning without executing. The world awaits, but you're hesitating at the threshold.

cards.numerology: 2 - Duality, partnership, balance, choice, the crossroads

kabbalah.path: 12 - The path of the Magical Intelligence
kabbalah.meaning: The wisdom of action through balanced masculine force

cards.affirmation: I confidently choose my path and embrace worldly expansion.
cards.career: Business expansion, strategic partnerships, exploring new markets
cards.relationships: Deciding between potential partners, long-distance relationships, future planning together
cards.spirituality: Exploring different spiritual paths, expanding consciousness

cards.name: Three of Wands

meanings.upright: Your ships are coming in. The initial plans are bearing fruit and expansion is occurring. You've done the work and now opportunities are arriving from afar. Leadership and collaboration bring success. Foresight pays off.
meanings.reversed: Delays in expected results or returns. You may have lacked foresight in your planning, or obstacles are blocking your progress. Ships may be coming, but they're delayed. Patience and reassessment are needed.

cards.numerology: 3 - Creation, expression, growth, the triangle of manifestation

kabbalah.path: 13 - The path of the Uniting Intelligence
kabbalah.meaning: Understanding through creative expansion and enterprise

cards.affirmation: I welcome abundance as my creative visions manifest into reality.
cards.career: Successful ventures, business growth, international opportunities, teamwork
cards.relationships: Growing together, successful partnerships, supportive community
cards.spirituality: Spiritual growth, expanding consciousness, receiving spiritual guidance

cards.name: Four of Wands

meanings.upright: A time of celebration and harmony. The four wands create a canopy of blessing—this is the completion of a phase worthy of recognition. Community support, stable foundations, and joyful gatherings. Milestones reached and celebrated.
meanings.reversed: Celebration feels hollow or is postponed. Lack of community support or unstable foundations in your endeavors. Family conflicts may be disrupting your sense of home and belonging.

cards.numerology: 4 - Structure, foundation, stability, the square of manifestation

kabbalah.path: 14 - The path of the Illuminating Intelligence
kabbalah.meaning: Mercy and blessing through stable creative foundations

cards.affirmation: I celebrate my achievements and honor the community that supports me.
cards.career: Successful project completion, workplace celebrations, team harmony
cards.relationships: Weddings, engagements, housewarmings, community gatherings
cards.spirituality: Spiritual community, celebration of spiritual milestones, group rituals

cards.name: Five of Wands

meanings.upright: Conflict and competition are present, but not necessarily destructive. Multiple energies are clashing, creating tension and struggle. This may be healthy competition or disagreements about direction. Navigate with awareness.
meanings.reversed: Conflict resolution is possible. Inner harmony is being restored, or you're learning to avoid unnecessary battles. Cooperation emerges from chaos. A respite from struggle.

cards.numerology: 5 - Change, challenge, instability, the pentagram of transformation

kabbalah.path: 15 - The path of the Radical Intelligence
kabbalah.meaning: The severity of creative conflict that leads to transformation

cards.affirmation: I navigate conflict with grace and learn from competitive energies.
cards.career: Workplace competition, conflicting ideas, healthy rivalry, debates
cards.relationships: Arguments, clashing personalities, competition for attention
cards.spirituality: Spiritual battles, wrestling with beliefs, refining through challenge

cards.name: Six of Wands

meanings.upright: Victory and public recognition are yours. The rider returns triumphant with the wand of authority raised high. Others acknowledge your success and leadership. A time of confidence and deserved celebration.
meanings.reversed: Victory that goes unrecognized or is kept private. Excessive pride may be alienating others. Fear of success or difficulty accepting praise. Recognition delayed but not denied.

cards.numerology: 6 - Harmony, balance, service, the hexagram of completion

kabbalah.path: 16 - The path of the Triumphant Intelligence
kabbalah.meaning: Beauty and harmony through creative victory

cards.affirmation: I graciously accept recognition and celebrate my victories.

cards.relationships: Relationship success, being admired, public relationship milestones
cards.spirituality: Spiritual achievements, recognition as a teacher or guide

cards.name: Seven of Wands

meanings.upright: You must defend your position against challenges from all sides. Standing your ground requires courage and conviction. This is not the time to retreat—you have the high ground if you maintain your stance with integrity.
meanings.reversed: Feeling overwhelmed by opposition. You may be considering giving up or unable to maintain your defense. Exhaustion from constant battles. Need to choose which fights are worth engaging.

cards.numerology: 7 - Mysticism, analysis, assessment, the septenary of reflection

kabbalah.path: 17 - The path of the Disposing Intelligence
kabbalah.meaning: Enduring victory through steadfast defense of one's creative vision

cards.affirmation: I stand my ground with courage and defend what I believe in.

cards.relationships: Defending the relationship, standing up for yourself, boundary setting
cards.spirituality: Defending spiritual beliefs, perseverance in practice, spiritual warfare

cards.name: Eight of Wands

meanings.upright: Things are moving fast! Swift action, rapid progress, and quick communication characterize this time. Delays are over and momentum is building. Travel may be indicated. Decisions happen quickly now.

cards.numerology: 8 - Power, abundance, authority, the octave of manifestation

kabbalah.path: 18 - The path of the Active Intelligence
kabbalah.meaning: Glory through swift and decisive creative action

cards.relationships: Relationship moving quickly, fast communication, passionate intensity
cards.spirituality: Rapid spiritual growth, sudden insights, quick energetic shifts

cards.name: Nine of Wands

meanings.upright: You've been through battles and you're weary, but you stand ready to defend what you've built. The Nine of Wands represents the final test before completion—resilience and persistence are required. You're stronger than you know.
meanings.reversed: Exhaustion and burnout from constant vigilance. Paranoia or excessive defensiveness may be alienating others. You may be ready to give up just before the finish line. Rest and restore.

cards.numerology: 9 - Completion, wisdom, integration, the ennead of fulfillment

kabbalah.path: 19 - The path of the Secret Intelligence
kabbalah.meaning: Foundation through the resilience of creative fire

cards.affirmation: I have the strength to persevere through any challenge.

cards.relationships: Protecting the relationship, overcoming past wounds, staying committed
cards.spirituality: Spiritual resilience, maintaining practice through difficulties

cards.name: Ten of Wands

meanings.upright: You carry a heavy burden of responsibility and hard work. The creative cycle is complete but exhausting. You've achieved much but at a cost. This is the weight of success—time to consider what can be released.
meanings.reversed: It's time to release the burden. Delegate what you can and let go of unnecessary responsibilities. Recovery from burnout. Learning to say no and lighten your load.

cards.numerology: 10 - Completion, new cycle beginning, the perfection of manifestation

kabbalah.path: 20 - The path of the Kingdom
kabbalah.meaning: The full manifestation of creative fire in the material world

cards.spirituality: Spiritual burdens, releasing ego attachments, completion of spiritual work

cards.name: Page of Wands

meanings.upright: A messenger of creative potential arrives. The Page of Wands represents new ideas, enthusiasm, and the spirit of adventure. This is the explorer who sets out with passion but little plan. Fresh energy and exciting possibilities.
meanings.reversed: Unfocused enthusiasm leads nowhere. Lack of direction or follow-through. Procrastination masks fear. The message may be delayed or disappointing. Mature your approach to your passions.

cards.relationships: New romantic interest, playful energy, adventurous dating
cards.spirituality: Spiritual exploration, new practices, discovering spiritual interests

meanings.upright: The Knight charges forward with passion and courage. This is action-oriented energy—bold, adventurous, and charismatic. Things happen quickly now. A passionate pursuit of goals with fearless determination.

cards.numerology: Knight corresponds to 12/3 - Creative expression through action
cards.astrology: Scorpio (the fixed water sign ruled by Mars)

cards.relationships: Passionate pursuit, whirlwind romance, adventurous partner
cards.spirituality: Active spiritual practice, passionate devotion, dynamic meditation

cards.numerology: Queen corresponds to 13/4 - Manifestation through creative authority

cards.spirituality: Spiritual authority, confident practice, warm spiritual leadership

meanings.reversed: Leadership becomes tyranny. Impulsiveness leads to poor decisions. Ruthlessness in pursuit of goals alienates others. Unrealistic expectations create disappointment. Temper fire with wisdom.

cards.numerology: King corresponds to 14/5 - Leadership through creative change
cards.astrology: Leo (the fixed fire sign ruled by the Sun)

kabbalah.meaning: The pure wisdom of creative fire in mastery

meanings.reversed: Acceptance of loss allows you to move forward. Hope returns as you release grief. Finding peace with what has passed. Recovery from disappointment. The remaining cups are now visible.
